question: With identical sourced principles and reconstructed actions, does conditioning actions on the correctly matched state-specific decision improve independently held-out complete rooms beyond separate supervision, retrieval and ordinary feedback?
implemented_this_batch: Prospective ordinary object-preservation, box-overlap and rectangular-boundary filter evaluated against all 72 archived decisions
Per-object missingness and per-pair newly introduced overlap accounting alongside frozen aggregate scores
Full 24-unit supervision ledger and retrospective completion-horizon analysis of two existing Waterloo transitions
not_implemented_or_run_this_batch: Learned effect predictor or decision model
Multi-step search or policy with the new filter in the loop
New native scene generation or editing
New training or whole-room preference evaluation

candidate_training_objective.X: Identical pre-action observations, user task, source knowledge and allowed tools
candidate_training_objective.D: Source-supported principle applied to the reconstructed state; not an original designer's historical tool trace
candidate_training_objective.A: Same tool action target in both arms
candidate_training_objective.normalization: Use the audited equal-material phase/token weighting; match update and inference budgets and disclose remaining differences
candidate_training_objective.deployment: D must be generated at inference. Never supply the test demonstration reason or after-state as a prompt
candidate_training_objective.theory_limit: This is standard conditional likelihood factorization, not a new loss or a guarantee that generated reasons improve actions. Teacher-forced action accuracy is insufficient. A finite-data optimization or generalization benefit must be measured.

evaluation_units.hard_invariants: Explicit required instance IDs, immutable transforms, and declared supported geometric/access constraints
evaluation_units.granularity: Retain aggregate scores but also track per-object and per-pair changes. A predicate already false can hide additional damage
evaluation_units.phase_goals: A coordinated table/chair transition may temporarily lose alignment at a recorded endpoint; functional goals may be judged at a bounded plan endpoint where the task allows this
evaluation_units.shared_planning_rule: Any bounded joint-edit allowance must be identical for ordinary search and learned policies. Intermediate operations count against the same budget; no waiver for collision, required-instance loss or unverified swept motion
evaluation_units.unknown: Unsupported geometry, professional preference, continuous motion and whole-room acceptance stay unknown
evaluation_units.scope_limit: Current new-pair and new-outside-ID accounting still does not measure worsening penetration/excursion within an existing violation

required_controls: Frozen backbone with the same knowledge and adequate task prompt
Ordinary code/keyword retrieval with the same knowledge corpus
Ordinary geometric/activity feedback and bounded search with identical tools
Action-only adaptation as a secondary control
Same-material separate versus correctly paired supervision as the primary test
before_additional_training: Reconcile the latest 920 training completion record; Git contains only an old start snapshot
Recover exact original image inputs or explicitly define a new dataset version; do not replace missing originals silently
Review positive supervision at a justified completion horizon without admitting failed or mixed outcomes automatically
Obtain state-dependent decisions across independent project families; the present six-family, eight-reason corpus is a mechanism-development set
Freeze project splits and evaluate free-running complete trajectories, not only teacher-forced prefixes
continue_if: Paired supervision improves actual requested outcomes or cost over the same-material and ordinary-method controls on independent projects without damaging retained requirements
revise_or_stop_scaling_if: Only format/stop behavior or geometry-filter repairs improve; retrieval explains the effect; gains require ground-truth reasons; benefits remain confined to the training-exposed family
